items.excerpt: 🇮🇱⚡️ — Israeli Chief of Staff during the first training of the new 38th Division: “This week we commemorate the 53rd anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, and three years since October 7th, two painful failures with a common thread. The lesson we must all learn from both wars is that the surprise scenario must occupy us all, and the Israeli army must always be prepared for a surprise war.”

items.headline: 𝗕𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚: MoD approves retrofit of Counter‑UAS on active MBTs
